falsifiable_hypothesis: The active raw B gain vector is inferred from exactly K=3 authenticated inner whole-patient folds. A natural one-fold-equivalent hierarchical regularization step is to replace exactly 1/K of each active raw target gain by its fitting-only reliability-weighted common-gain counterpart, while leaving the fallback branch untouched. This ties regularization strength to the fixed resampling structure instead of an arbitrary continuous hyperparameter.
gain_rule: Reproduce weighted_median_common_bias_theta through raw/fallback B gain g_raw, prior gain g0, gain reliability r_g, and use_raw. If use_raw is false, preserve the frozen fallback gain. If use_raw is true, let delta_j=g_raw,j-g0,j and mu_g=sum_j r_g,j*delta_j/sum_j r_g,j, with mu_g=0 only when all gain reliabilities are zero. Define g_common,j=clip(g0,j+mu_g,[0.875,3]). With fixed K=3 inner folds deploy gB_j=(1-1/K)*g_raw,j+(1/K)*g_common,j = (2/3)g_raw,j+(1/3)g_common,j.
theta_rule: Reproduce weighted_median_common_bias_theta exactly after constructing deployed gB: compute theta bias reliability r_theta; orientation A uses thetaA=theta_full+(1+r_theta)*bias; for B use weights w_j=gB_j^2*r_theta,j and the tuning-free weighted median of bias_j as mu_B, then thetaB=theta_full+bias+mu_B+r_theta*(bias-mu_B).
strength_rationale: The gain shrink strength is exactly 1/K where K=3 is the protocol's fixed number of inner whole-patient folds. No continuous strength search, per-target strength, fold rescue, or outer-held routing exists in canonical replay. This family remains repeated adaptive development because prior outer outcomes were inspected.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
